services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Harbor Lights Marina makes it easy to enjoy a fun-filled day on beautiful Chickamauga Lake with our convenient boat rentals near Chattanooga, Tennessee. Choose from our premium fleet of pontoons, double-decker pontoons with slides, and ski boats, perfect for family outings, group lake days, cruising, tubing, swimming, and making memories on the water. Guests can also enhance their rental experience with available add-ons, including tubes, paradise pads, and upgraded life vests.
